description: Interview questions and practice. For "help me prepare for my interview", "what will they ask a staff nurse?", "do a mock interview". Gives likely role questions, questions drawn from the advert, behavioural questions, good questions to ask them, tips for one-way video and AI interviews, and an order for a practice interview with timings. Takes a job id from a search, or the role and company.

id.description: A job id from a search result, copied exactly. Optional if what is given.

what.description: The role, for example "staff nurse" or "data analyst".
